{{short description|American statistician}}
'''Cathy Ann Furlong''' is an American statistician active in volunteer work for statistical organizations.{{r|chance}} She is the former president of Statistics Without Borders,{{r|swb}} and represents the US in the [[International Statistical Institute]] Committee on Women in Statistics.{{r|isi}}

==Education and career==
Furlong earned a master's degree in statistics from [[American University]], under the mentorship of [[Mary W. Gray]], who also later encouraged her in her volunteer work.{{r|swb|interview}} She worked in the public school system as a mathematics and statistics teacher until retiring in 2008,{{r|interview}}  and continues to work as a [[Medicare (United States)|Medicare]] and [[Medicaid]] fraud investigator{{r|swb|interview}} for Integrity Management Services, Inc.{{r|isi}}

==Volunteer work==
Furlong was the chair of Statistics Without Borders from 2014 to 2018,{{r|chance}} and continues to serve as its past chair.{{r|swb}} The organization provides statistical consulting on a volunteer basis, particularly to organizations and countries in the developing world; as of 2015, it had approximately 1400 members.{{r|interview}}

She is one of three US representatives on the [[International Statistical Institute]] Committee on Women in Statistics,{{r|isi}} and has also been active in the [[Caucus for Women in Statistics]],{{r|swb}} including serving as its membership coordinator.{{r|cws}}

==Recognition==
In 2017 the [[American Statistical Association]] elected Furlong as a fellow.{{r|fasa}}
